notes: The in-progress marker now admits when it cannot be trusted. A ring that never breathes used to mean either 'nobody is on it' or 'the heartbeat was never switched on for this project' - identical on screen. Stasys now knows the difference and says so in the card panel, with the fix, and it can tell an ended session from a hook that was never installed. And if your newest write-up names different cards than the one wearing the ring, the card and the header chip turn amber: the marker may be out of date. The gold stays - it asks a question rather than overruling you - and nothing ever moves on its own.
